verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Gateway JIT Funding sends funding requests to your system at transaction time, and your system approves or denies each one with its own business rules. That is real-time per-authorization decisioning. The evidence never documents the response time budget or any timeout or stand-in fallback the developer controls, and the webhooks docs cover event notifications only, not decisioning. Missing for 10: documented response time budget, documented timeout fallback behavior that the developer configures, endpoint/protocol details for answering auth requests, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can approve or decline each authorization in real time — a webhook or auth-stream endpoint my code answers inside the network's time budget, with a documented timeout fallback I control

citations.quote: The Marqeta platform enables you to fund accounts at transaction time using your system to make funding decisions. Your system receives funding requests and approves or denies them using your own business rules.
